title: @Query with % operator rejected at startup: relax Hibernate JPQL compliance (BadJpqlGrammarException mismatched input '%')
errorSample:
Caused by: org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.query.BadJpqlGrammarException: At 1:38 and token '%', mismatched input '%', expecting one of the following tokens: <EOF>, ',', '[', '/', '||', '.', '*', AND, BY, DAY, EPOCH, EXCEPT, FETCH, GROUP, HAVING, HOUR, INTERSECT, LIMIT, MINUTE, MONTH, NANOSECOND, OFFSET, OR, ORDER, QUARTER, SECOND, UNION, WEEK, YEAR, '+', '-'; Bad HQL grammar [select c from Call c where c.duration % 2 = 0 order by c.id]

	at org.antlr.v4.runtime.ProxyErrorListener.syntaxError(ProxyErrorListener.java:41) ~[antlr4-runtime-4.13.2.jar:4.13.2]

	at org.antlr.v4.runtime.DefaultErrorStrategy.reportInputMismatch(DefaultErrorStrategy.java:327) ~[antlr4-runtime-4.13.2.jar:4.13.2]
	at org.antlr.v4.runtime.DefaultErrorStrategy.reportError(DefaultErrorStrategy.java:139) ~[antlr4-runtime-4.13.2.jar:4.13.2]
	at org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.query.HqlParser.start(HqlParser.java:394) ~[spring-data-jpa-4.0.7.jar:4.0.7]

	at org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.query.JpaQueryEnhancer$HqlQueryParser.parseQuery(JpaQueryEnhancer.java:298) ~[spring-data-jpa-4.0.7.jar:4.0.7]
	at org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.query.JpaQueryEnhancer.forHql(JpaQueryEnhancer.java:159) ~[spring-data-jpa-4.0.7.jar:4.0.7]
	at org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.query.QueryEnhancerFactories$BuiltinQueryEnhancerFactories$3.create(QueryEnhancerFactories.java:91) ~[spring-data-jpa-4.0.7.jar:4.0.7]
symptom: The application context fails to start with QueryCreationException caused by BadJpqlGrammarException: mismatched input '%' for an @Query that uses the modulo operator in a where clause.
cause: Hibernate runs in a JPQL-compatibility mode in which only operators defined by the Jakarta Persistence specification are accepted, and the remainder operator % is not one of them, so the query is refused when the repository is created.
fixSummary: Disable the JPQL compliance mode in application.properties: spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.jpa.compliance.query=false. Hibernate then parses the query with its full HQL grammar, which supports the % operator, and the repository bean is created.
